title: 범죄와 안전: 사고가 나면, 도둑이 들면 어떻게 해요?
objective: By the end, you can understand and use 10 words about crime and safety, such as 신고하다, 사기, 피해, and 목격하다, in short sentences about everyday incidents.
summary: Learn 10 words for crime, accidents, prevention, and reporting to the police in everyday Korean life.

task.title: Use the safety words
task.line: Read each sentence and choose, write, or complete the word from the list that fits the situation.

words.example: 이 동네는 범죄가 거의 없어서 밤에도 걸어 다닐 수 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: There is almost no crime in this neighborhood, so you can walk around even at night.

words.meaning: to report (to the police or an office)
words.exampleMeaning: I lost my wallet, so I reported it at the police station.

words.meaning: thief, burglar (도둑이 들다: a burglar breaks in)
words.exampleMeaning: I heard a burglar broke into the house next door last night.

words.meaning: scam, fraud (사기를 당하다: to get scammed)
words.exampleMeaning: I tried to buy something cheap online and got scammed.

words.example: 사기 피해를 입으면 바로 은행에 연락하세요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you lose money to a scam, contact your bank right away.
They put CCTV cameras in the alley to prevent crime.

words.example: 퇴근길에 사고가 나서 길이 많이 막혔어요.
words.exampleMeaning: There was an accident on my way home from work, so the traffic was heavy.

words.meaning: to witness, to see (an incident) happen
words.exampleMeaning: If you saw the accident happen, please contact us.

words.meaning: criminal, the person who did it
words.exampleMeaning: The police caught the criminal three days later.

exercises: Choose the right word: 가게 물건을 (훔친 / 예방한) 사람이 CCTV에 찍혔어요.
Fill in the blank with the right form of 신고하다: 길에서 싸우는 사람을 보면 바로 112에 ____.
Fill in the blank with 도둑, 사기, or 사고: ① ____이 창문을 깨고 들어와서 노트북을 가져갔어요. ② 은행 직원이라고 하면서 비밀번호를 묻는 전화는 ____일 수 있어요. ③ 눈길에서 차가 미끄러져서 ____가 났어요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 그 일을 자기 눈으로 직접 ____한 사람이 경찰에게 범인의 얼굴을 설명했어요.
Fill in the blank with 범인, 피해, or 예방: ① 경찰이 아직 ____을 찾고 있어요. ② 보이스피싱 ____를 줄이려면 모르는 번호의 전화를 조심하세요. ③ 손을 자주 씻으면 감기를 ____할 수 있어요.
Write the Korean word from the list: an act that breaks the law, such as stealing or cheating people.
answers: ① 도둑 ② 사기 ③ 사고
① 범인 ② 피해 ③ 예방
